evals.prompt: Generate a landing-page hero image for Technauts — headline 'Ship telemetry that trusts itself', subhead 'Real-time satellite health, without the guesswork', and a 'Start free trial' button, with a browser-chrome mockup of the product behind it. I also need a square version for social.
evals.expected_output: The skill drafts a paragraph prompt naming every assigned layer in reading order with the literal headline, subhead, and CTA copy quoted verbatim, runs the anti-slop gate against that prompt before generating, calls generate_image with style_type: "DESIGN" and aspect_ratio: "16x9" for the base hero, then calls reframe_image on the base generation's response_id with aspect_ratio: "1x1" to produce the social variant instead of a second independent generate_image call, and saves a compositional-deconstruction JSON tagging Nav Bar, Hero Copy Zone, CTA Placement, and Device Frame/Chrome elements.
expectations: The skill actually calls generate_image and reframe_image rather than only printing a drafted prompt.
The generation prompt contains the exact user-supplied headline, subhead, and CTA copy verbatim, not paraphrased or replaced with placeholder text.
reframe_image is called with the base generation's response_id, not a second independent generate_image call for the square variant.
The compositional deconstruction is bbox-structured JSON with elements tagged by compositional layer name, not a paragraph description.
Results (prompt, deconstruction JSON, both image URLs) are saved to a project file rather than left only in the conversation.

evals.prompt: I need a device mockup showing VoiceHive's app running on a laptop, sitting on a desk, for the pitch deck.
evals.expected_output: The skill assigns Background/Environment, Device Frame/Chrome, Supporting UI Chrome, and Product Visual layers (no Nav Bar layer, since this format has none per mockup-anatomy.md), calls generate_image with style_type: "REALISTIC" (not "DESIGN", since this is a photographic device-in-context shot) and makes no reframe_image call since no additional placement was requested, and saves a compositional deconstruction consistent with this format's layer set.
expectations: No reframe_image call occurs, since the prompt requests only one placement.
The compositional deconstruction contains no Nav Bar, Hero Copy Zone, or CTA Placement elements, consistent with this format's layer table.
The skill actually calls generate_image rather than only drafting a prompt.

evals.prompt: Make an App Store screenshot showing the VoiceHive dashboard — sidebar nav, a couple of stat cards, a call-volume chart.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the anti-slop gate against a first-draft prompt, catches under-specified chart/data-specificity (a chart with no real metric or trend named), revises the prompt to name a real call-volume metric and trend before calling generate_image with style_type: "DESIGN", and saves a compositional deconstruction with Nav Bar/Sidebar and Supporting UI Chrome elements only (no Device Frame/Chrome, no CTA Placement, per this format's layer table).
expectations: The skill's drafted prompt names a specific chart label and plausible data values/trend for the call-volume chart, not "a chart".
The anti-slop gate is applied before generate_image is called, not skipped or applied only after.
The compositional deconstruction contains no Device Frame/Chrome or CTA Placement elements, consistent with the dashboard-screenshot format's layer table.
The skill actually calls generate_image rather than only printing a prompt.
